name: Cable Kneeling Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing away from the machine with an end in each hand.
Brace your core, hinge slightly forward, and position your bent elbows beside your ears.
Straighten both elbows to extend your hands forward beyond your head.
Bend your elbows under control to return the rope behind your head.
tips: Keep your upper arms beside your head as your forearms move.
Avoid arching your lower back or letting your elbows flare outward as you extend.
